item.text:
**Assessment**
Mixed, leaning `partly yes` on formal anti-capture reform, but `weak on practice`. In 2024 Abiy’s government advanced governance reforms that should reduce corruption and politically connected privilege, but the record still shows opaque coercive power, leverage-seeking state behavior, and no strong public proof of sustained anti-corruption enforcement against insiders.

**Accepted Claims**
- [IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The IMF said Ethiopia’s reform agenda aimed to restore debt sustainability, end monetary financing, tighten monetary policy, mobilize revenue, and strengthen SOE finances. This supports a reading of rules-based reform rather than patronage or rent extraction. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `5B.1`

- [The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/29/the-federal-democratic-republic-of-ethiopia-request-of-an-arrangement-under-the-extended-552778) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The staff report tied reform to debt sustainability, inflation control, market-determined FX, prudent fiscal management, and SOE oversight, including government-independent directors and an independent NBE supervisor. This is direct evidence of anti-capture institutional design. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `5B.2`

- [The National Bank of Ethiopia Announces the Launch of a New Monetary Policy Framework](https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-national-bank-of-ethiopia-announces-the-launch-of-a-new-monetary-policy-framework/) | National Bank of Ethiopia | 2024-07-09 | NBE said it was modernizing monetary policy around price stability, an interest-rate-based regime, stronger technical capacity, and market-based transmission. That is a pro-credibility move that points away from politically connected or arbitrary allocation. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `5B.2`

- [The Council of Ministers today approved the draft NBE Proclamation and Banking Business Proclamation](https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-council-of-ministers-today-approved-the-draft-nbe-proclamation-and-banking-business-proclamation/) | National Bank of Ethiopia | 2024-06-14 | The draft laws were described as strengthening credibility, accountability, transparency, and governance in the central bank and banking sector. This is strong formal evidence for reducing favoritism in finance. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.2`

- [World Bank Backs Ethiopia's Reforms to Promote Sustainable and Inclusive Growth, Enhance Resilience, and Take Climate Action](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth) | World Bank | 2024-07-30 | The World Bank said the package would improve fiscal transparency, financial stability, public-spending effectiveness, SOE performance, private-sector orientation, and social safety nets. This supports a more competitive, less politically captured economic environment. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `5B.1`

- [Ethiopia signs 1.72 billion USD Financing Agreements with the World Bank](https://www.mofed.gov.et/blog/ethiopia-signs-172-billion-usd-financing-agreements-with-the-world-bank/) | Ethiopia Ministry of Finance | 2024-04-05 | The ministry said the projects funded rural connectivity, food security, adaptive safety nets, power-sector reform, and water/sanitation. These are public-good investments rather than obvious connected-business privileges. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.1`, `5B.3`

- [Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland's Red Sea port](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/) | Reuters | 2024-01-01 | Reuters reported the Berbera MOU tied port access to possible recognition and naval use, which was widely treated as leverage-seeking and destabilizing. This is negative evidence against fair, neutral rules and suggests geopolitical bargaining rather than clean market governance. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.1`

- [Ethiopia extends state of emergency in Amhara](https://kelo.com/2024/02/02/ethiopia-extends-state-of-emergency-in-amhara/) | Reuters | 2024-02-02 | Parliament extended emergency rule amid insurgency and heavy casualties. That signals an unstable and coercive governing environment, which weakens clean competition and makes capture harder to rule out. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `4B.10`

- [Ethiopia’s deepening crackdown on dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-04 | HRW reported arbitrary arrests, repression of critics, and broad arbitrary detention. While not a corruption report, it is negative evidence for accountable, impartial institutions and suggests state power still favored coercive insiders over open scrutiny. | `5B.5`, `4B.9`, `4B.10`, `5B.4`

- [Ethiopia authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/) | Amnesty International | 2024-02-19 | Amnesty said emergency powers were used for warrantless arrests, movement limits, and bans on assemblies. This is indirect but meaningful negative evidence because a politically unaccountable emergency environment is fertile ground for favoritism and capture. | `5B.5`, `4B.9`, `4B.10`, `5B.4`

- [Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | HRW said the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms. That is selective punishment of watchdogs, which undercuts the credibility of anti-corruption and anti-favoritism claims. | `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `4B.9`, `4B.10`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 reporting showing Abiy personally prosecuted corruption, dismantled a major oligarchic network, or directly removed politically connected business privileges.
- I also did not find a clean source demonstrating family-member favoritism in economic appointments during 2024.
- So the best-supported reading is: `real anti-capture institutional reform on paper`, but `insufficient evidence of decisive anti-corruption enforcement in practice`.
